summary: Visits Analysis - Member Details - Add Unique Visits column
description_plain:
Add a Unique Visits column to the Visits Analysis - Member Details paginated report.

1. Unique Visits counts one unique visit per calendar day per member, aligned to the Glofox dashboard.
2. Example on ticket: 51 event-based visits vs 19 distinct visit days for the same member/period.
3. Product has not replied to Option A vs Option B on the ticket.
4. Excel export was requested and not separately signed off.
5. Performance testing: Not performed/documented.

Not included in this change:
- Production RLS, workspace access, and capacity settings.
- Switching to an alternate metric definition not approved on the ticket.

How it is deployed:
Publish updated paginated report to Glofox Analyze workspace only.
